central_claim: A replication-stress (ATR) vulnerability is inherited from the published FET-fusion class mechanism and is internally consistent in public data, but the document reports no EMC-specific ATR vulnerability: the class precondition splits by fusion type, the CRISPR/drug-response surrogate tests mostly fail to track the mechanism, and the EMC tumour transcriptome grades only WEAK.
